name: bibbly
description: Bibbly: live multilingual captions, meeting clarity, tasks and the Bibbly Stick.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bibbly/core && npm run build -w @bibbly/server && npm run build -w @bibbly/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bibbly/core && npm run test -w @bibbly/server
scripts.firmware:test: cmake -S firmware/bibbly-stick/host -B build/firmware-host -G Ninja && cmake --build build/firmware-host && ctest --test-dir build/firmware-host --output-on-failure
